notes: G3 spec (amount+1 on the cast count). Printed: '... you may cast A creature spell from among cards exiled with this artifact without paying its mana cost.' The Idol's entry exiles Alpine Watchdog and Igneous Cur (both mana value 2). The ability is activated and Igneous Cur is cast through its permission: exactly one spell, so the Cur enters, the permission is used up and the menu no longer offers the Watchdog, which stays in exile. Ontology round R13: the activation makes a PERMIT; the cast is a menu row through it (cast:<card>:via:<idol>).
